text:
Alex CSM: Heads-up — LumenBridge hit rate limits during their sandbox run. They asked for a short QPS bump + IP/header allowlist for their engineers running the onboarding lab.
Mina NetOps: OK. Need CIDRs, regions, window, and whether to auto-revoke.
Alex CSM: CIDRs: 198.51.102.0/24 (eng VMs) + 2001:db8:1::/64 (CI). Regions: us-east4 for lab, eu-west3 for EU observers. Window: 2 hours starting 10:00 ET. Auto-revoke yes. Tag: renewal_watch:medium.
Victor AM: This customer renews in ~5w; success here helps renewal. I'll capture NPS.
Mina NetOps: I'll apply temporary rate-window to key lumen-sandbox-10am and add CIDRs to ingress list. ETA ~10m. @Ops Bot please open ticket.
Ops Bot: ticket CS-9022 created — temporary qps bump + ingress allowlist. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9022
Rae Support: I'll stand up a dashboard for 429/5xx and set alerts: 429 > 2.5% or p95 latency > 800ms. Give me the key name.
Alex CSM: Key: lb-sandbox-2026. Rotate after window. Also please capture any failed request ids.
Mina NetOps: Applied CIDRs and rate-window. Auto-revoke scheduled at 12:00 ET. Peering request opened for eu-west3; will update with IP. Added tag customer:lumenbridge and session:onboard-2026-04-02.
Rae Support: Dashboards live. Annotated CS-9022. Pager if thresholds hit.
Mina NetOps: Peering IP provisioned: 35.199.88.101. CS-9022 updated.
Victor AM: I'll run enablement at 10:15 ET and collect quick NPS + verbatim feedback if any UX issues.
Alex CSM: Quick routing fallback suggestion from Eng: route non-interactive analysis to small-model to preserve budget. Snippet:
```
route:
  if header.x-customer == "lumenbridge":
    - name: onboard-bump
      override_rate: 6rps
      regions: [us-east4, eu-west3]
    - name: analysis-fallback
      model: small-analytic
      when: request.path startswith "/batch"
```
Mina NetOps: Will keep that in mind; applied only rate/CIDR for now.
Alex CSM: Checklist: [x] CIDRs added, [x] rate-window, [x] dashboards, [x] ticket CS-9022, [ ] post-session NPS + request ids. I'll post results after the lab. :thumbsup:
